test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Pilgrimmage** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is '**Pilgrimage**'. • The incorrect spelling has an extra '**m**' in it. • **Pilgrimage **means a journey to a sacred place for religious reasons. (धार्मिक कारणों से किसी पवित्र स्थान की यात्रा) • **Example**: *Many Hindus undertake a pilgrimage to the holy city of Varanasi.* Thus, **option 4** is the correct answer. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Procedure **means a series of actions taken to accomplish a task. (किसी कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए की गई कार्रवाइयों की एक श्रृंखला) • **Procession **means a group of people or vehicles moving in a formal or ceremonial way. (औपचारिक तरीके से चलने वाले लोगों या वाहनों का एक समूह) • **Prescription **means a written order for medicine or treatment given by a doctor. (किसी डॉक्टर द्वारा दिया गया दवा या उपचार के लिए लिखित आदेश) 3e:T56c, The correct answer is: **This type is the quietest and most efficient style of humidifier**.
